Name: Spiders are Bears
Author: osmiacyril
Description:
Inspired by aliserh's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrim/mods/67855]Spiders Begone[/url]﻿ mod for Skyrim, this mod for Stardew Valley turns the new jumping spiders in the challenge mode of the mines into bears.

I don't have arachnophobia myself, but I figured something like this might be helpful to have around, whether it'll help by changing the textures to something other than spiders or whether it'll just be fun to have bears jumping around in the mines. Let me know if there's something else I should change about the textures or any other spider textures in the game you'd like to see changed.

This mod does the following:
- changes spider enemy textures in the challenge mode mines to bears
- changes spiderweb textures in the challenge mode mines to orange leaves
- removes spiderwebs on the walls of the quarry mine
- removes spiders, eggs, and webs from the spirit's eve maze (and replaces them with bears and leaves)

How to install:
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]﻿2. Download the mod file from the downloads page
3. Unzip the mod file
4. Copy the folder titled "OC - Spiders are Bears 1.4" into the mods folder in your Stardew Valley folder (the same way you install any SMAPI mod)

What if I only want some textures to be changed, but not others?
1. Open config.json in the folder for this mod.
2. Change "On" to "Off" for whatever specific texture patch you want to disable:
﻿SpiderEnemyRetexture = Jumping spider enemies in the challenge mode mines become bears
﻿MineWebRetexture = Sticky spiderwebs in the challenge mode mines become leaves
﻿SpiritsEveMazeRetexture = Spiders, Eggs, and Webs in the Spirit's Eve Maze become leaves and bears
﻿QuarryMineRetexture = Webs in the quarry mine are removed
3. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can edit all of these options from the mod config menu instead if you want.


Note: this mod may conflict with some retexture mods. Most notably, if you use a mod that recolors grass and that mod is loaded by SMAPI after Spiders Are Bears, the spiderwebs in the hard mode mines might still show up as spiderwebs (depending on how your recolor mod edits grass.xnb). You might also encounter compatibility issues with any mods that recolor the festivals tilesheet (for spirit's eve maze spiders), the quarry mine (for quarry mine webs), or the jumping spiders themselves (hard mode mines spider enemies). Unfortunately, there isn't an easy way to fix this to my knowledge. If you really want to play with a specific recolor pack and are encountering issues, you could open that recolor pack's content.json and edit the way the next textures are loaded so they do not effect the same pixel ranges as the textures from spiders-are-bears on the effected tilesheets, or disable the edits they make to the effected tilesheets entirely. I'd recommend looking at contentpatcher's documentation, and you can also send me a message on here if you need help.

Downloads.Description: Unzip to your Mods folder. Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.
